items.text: In the hospital setting, 42 CFR 482.13(b) gives patients participation and informed-decision rights, including requesting or refusing treatment. The same provision does not turn the right into an entitlement to demand medically inappropriate services. HHS representative guidance makes the extent of representative authority depend on applicable law and circumstances. Capacity, minors, emergency exceptions, guardianship conflicts and state surrogate priority are **not resolved by a generic role title**. Establish the applicable rule for the case. [A01](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-42/chapter-IV/subchapter-G/part-482/subpart-B/section-482.13), [A09](https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/for-professionals/privacy/guidance/personal-representatives/index.html)
